places.name: Patan Durbar Square
places.description: A historic palace square in the heart of Patan, known for its Newari architecture, temples, courtyards, and traditional art.

places.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
places.description: A historic royal palace complex featuring ancient temples, courtyards, traditional architecture, and the famous Kumari Ghar.

places.name: Boudhanath Stupa
places.description: One of Nepal's most iconic Buddhist stupas, surrounded by monasteries, prayer wheels, shops, and Tibetan Buddhist culture.

places.name: Swayambhunath Stupa
places.description: An ancient Buddhist stupa situated on a hill overlooking Kathmandu Valley, offering beautiful views of the city.

places.name: Pashupatinath Temple
places.description: One of the most important Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Shiva, located along the banks of the Bagmati River.

places.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
places.description: A beautifully preserved historic square featuring traditional Newari architecture, temples, palaces, and intricate wood and stone carvings.

places.name: Garden of Dreams
places.description: A peaceful historic garden in central Kathmandu featuring landscaped gardens, fountains, pavilions, and relaxing open spaces.

places.name: Chandragiri Hills
places.description: A popular hill destination offering panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley and the Himalayan range, accessible by cable car.

places.name: Godawari Botanical Garden
places.description: A large botanical garden at the foot of the Phulchowki hills featuring diverse plants, flowers, walking trails, and peaceful green spaces.

places.name: Phulchowki
places.description: The highest hill surrounding Kathmandu Valley and a popular hiking destination known for forests, mountain views, and birdlife.

places.name: Kirtipur
places.description: An ancient Newari settlement known for traditional houses, temples, narrow streets, and panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley.
